# Process Engineer — Role-Specific Modules

> These four modules go deep into process engineering with AI assistance. Complete them after finishing the 8 shared modules.

## Module Sequence

| # | Module | Focus | Deliverable |
|---|--------|-------|-------------|
| PE-01 | [Process Mapping with AI Touchpoints](pe-01-process-mapping.prompt.md) | Map real processes and identify AI intervention opportunities | Annotated process map + AI opportunity matrix |
| PE-02 | [Bottleneck Analysis Framework](pe-02-bottleneck-analysis.prompt.md) | Data-driven bottleneck identification and root cause analysis | Reusable analysis framework + countermeasure plan |
| PE-03 | [AI-Enhanced SOP Generation](pe-03-sop-generation.prompt.md) | SOP template design, generation, and version control | Master SOP template + revision management workflow |
| PE-04 | [Continuous Improvement Metrics](pe-04-continuous-improvement.prompt.md) | KPIs, before/after analysis, statistical process control | Measurement framework + improvement dashboard |

## How to Use

1. Open the prompt file for your current module
2. Follow the instructions — each module has 4 parts plus a save step and stretch goal
3. Work with Copilot (and the `@process-engineer` agent) to produce each deliverable
4. Save outputs to `personas/process-engineer/workspace/artifacts/`
5. Mark the module complete in `personas/process-engineer/journey.md`

## Prerequisites

Complete the 8 shared modules first. They build the Copilot skills you'll use in these role-specific modules:
- Module 04 (Prompt Engineering) teaches you to write high-quality prompts
- Module 05 (Agent Design) teaches you to build custom agents
- Module 06 (Knowledge Capture) teaches you to structure knowledge for the knowledge base
